data.message: I commit to 18 tons this month, independently of others. Each Fisher01–25: opt in individually to 18, or name your alternative and any conditions. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra now if fulfilled. If k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k, remainder=250−8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). Even all18 leaves50, but recovery to500 isn't guaranteed; long-run gains aren't assured. Intentions aren't enforceable; other catches require recalculation. Who chooses18?
